description: This file defines the 'ReferencedObjectCollection' class, which manages a collection of object references used during serialization, deserialization, or copying in the Orleans framework. It handles reference tracking, lookup, and overflow management for objects and their identifiers.

classes.name: ReferencedObjectCollection
classes.description: A class that manages references to objects during serialization processes, supporting reference addition, lookup, overflow handling, and reset functionality.

methods.name: TryGetReferencedObject
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a referenced object by its reference ID.

methods.name: MarkValueField
methods.description: Marks a value field by incrementing the current reference ID.

methods.name: CreateRecordPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates a placeholder for a record and returns its reference ID.

methods.name: GetOrAddReference
methods.description: Gets an existing reference for a value or adds a new one, returning whether it was already present.

methods.name: GetReferenceIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a reference for a given object, or -1 if not found.

methods.name: CreateObjectToReferenceOverflow
methods.description: Handles overflow by creating a dictionary for object-to-reference mapping.

methods.name: AddToReferences
methods.description: Adds or updates a reference-object pair in the collection.

methods.name: ThrowReferenceExistsException
methods.description: Throws an exception if a reference already exists.

methods.name: RecordReferenceField
methods.description: Records a reference for a given object, automatically assigning a reference ID.

methods.name: RecordReferenceField
methods.description: Records a reference for a given object with a specified reference ID.

methods.name: CopyReferenceTable
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current reference-to-object mapping.

methods.name: CopyIdTable
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current object-to-reference ID mapping.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the collection, clearing all references and overflow data.
